transcript.answer:
I don't know. I couldn't find the pull request that added the spec tickets loop to the Loops tab. Lore memory only has these related facts:
- The Loops tab itself came from PR #3081 (2026-10-23). It replaced the Backlog and Triage tabs, and its first slice had only the implementation and triage loops.
- Spec FR14 describes a 'Spec tickets' pill on the Loops tab that is on by default for existing repositories.
- Spec FR9 says the Loops tab includes Spec tickets alongside six other loops.

None of these records name the PR that added the spec tickets loop. I'm not claiming #3081 did, because it only shipped the first slice.
sources: lore memory episode: FR14 Spec tickets pill on Loops tab (floor/code-review)
lore memory episode: FR9/FR9a/FR9b Loops tab includes Spec tickets (floor/code-review)

judgements.reason: The answer explicitly says it does not know which PR added the spec tickets loop and does not name #3392.
